title.en: Issues: filter by assignee, set due dates, preview images
title.zh: 议题支持按指派人筛选、设置截止日期和预览图片

title.en: Read status syncs across your devices
title.zh: 已读状态在多台设备间同步

title.en: Drag files into attachments; pasted rich text keeps its formatting
title.zh: 附件支持拖拽上传，粘贴富文本时保留格式

title.en: A missing model is now flagged at the model field
title.zh: 未填写模型时，提示直接显示在模型字段下方

title.en: Hermes signed in through its CLI no longer uses a custom endpoint or API key
title.zh: 通过 CLI 登录的 Hermes 不再沿用自定义接口地址和 API Key

title.en: Sign-in checks no longer read stored credentials from the macOS Keychain
title.zh: 登录检测不再读取 macOS 钥匙串中保存的凭据内容

title.en: Agent health warnings can be dismissed
title.zh: 智能体健康提醒可以关闭

title.en: Desktop releases bundle and verify the current agent connector
title.zh: 桌面版本打包并验证当前智能体连接器，避免携带旧版本
